question: Who among the following was given the Filmfare Award in the Best Choreographer category in 2008?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Saroj Khan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Filmfare Award for Best Choreography in 2008 was won by Saroj Khan for the **song "Barso Re"** from the movie **"Guru".**
 
• The Filmfare Award for Best Choreography is a prestigious accolade given by Filmfare magazine as part of its **annual Filmfare Awards for Hindi films**.
 
• The awards ceremony **began in 1954**, the** best choreography category** was introduced later, in **1989**.
 
• **Saroj Khan**:-
 
 
• Saroj Khan holds the record for the** most awards winner** in this category** (8 Times)**.
 
• She was the** first recipient** of this award in **1989 **when it was introduced.
 
• She achieved a hat trick by winning consecutively for **three years from 1989 to 1991**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Some Others Winners in Filmfare Award 2008 :-**

 
 
• **Shah Rukh Khan** won Best Actor for his role as a tough hockey coach in** "Chak De India!"**
 
• **Kareena Kapoor** took home** Best Actress **for her bubbly character in** "Jab We Met."**
 
• **Aamir Khan** won double! Best Film and Best Director for his heartwarming movie about a dyslexic child,** "Taare Zameen Par".**
 
• Other Wins:
 
• **Ranbir Kapoor** won **Best Debut (Male)** for his role in "Saawariya."
 
• **Deepika Padukone** won **Best Debut (Female)** for her part in the colorful "Om Shanti Om."
